*Niyyānikaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.67) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna, the final book of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Methodologically, the work analyzes conditional relations through the intersection of the *niyyānika-duka* (the dyad of states leading out to liberation and those not leading out) and the *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states) [SuttaCentral].

No external parallels are recorded for the text on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. Its most extensive textual overlaps occur with related combinatory sections, notably *Piṭṭhiduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.13 and Patthana 21.16), *Tika Kusalattika* (Patthana 5.2), and other dyad-triad treatments within the fifteenth division such as *Sauttaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.69, matching across §0.1–2.1) and *Sāsavaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.33) [DharmaNexus]. It also shares aligned text with the independent dyad treatment *Niyyānikaduka* (Patthana 14.34, §0.1–2.1 ↔ §0.1–3.1) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus finds no cross-language alignments with Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan corpora reaching its reporting threshold [DharmaNexus].
